```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(countrycode)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Gender Inequality Index
gii <- read_csv(
  "../Data/week4/gii.csv"
)

# World spatial data
world <- st_read(
  "../Data/week4/World_Countries_(Generalized)_-7542350475356456390/World_Countries_Generalized.shp"
)
```


```{r}

gii_raw <- read_csv(
  "../Data/week4/gii.csv",
  col_names = FALSE
)

print(gii_raw[1:15, 1:8])



gii |>
  filter(indexCode == "GII") |>
  distinct(indicatorCode, indicator) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```
```{r}

gii_change <- gii |>
  filter(
    indicatorCode == "gii",
    year %in% c(2010, 2019)
  ) |>
  select(
    iso3 = countryIsoCode,
    country,
    year,
    value
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "GII_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    gii_diff = GII_2019 - GII_2010
  )

head(gii_change)
```

```{r}
world_gii <- world |>
  mutate(
    iso3 = countrycode(ISO, "iso2c", "iso3c")
  ) |>
  left_join(gii_change, by = "iso3")


```


```{r}

# 查看结果
head(st_drop_geometry(world_gii))

# 成功匹配的空间要素数量
sum(!is.na(world_gii$gii_diff))

# 没有完整 GII 差值的空间要素数量
sum(is.na(world_gii$gii_diff))

world_gii |>
  filter(is.na(gii_diff)) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(COUNTRY, ISO, iso3)
```

```{r}


ggplot(world_gii) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = gii_diff),
    colour = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey85"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Global Change in Gender Inequality",
    subtitle = "2010–2019",
    fill = "Δ GII",
    caption = "Source: UNDP Human Development Reports"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
```

```{r}
# Improved map
library(tmap)

world_map <- world_gii|>
  filter(COUNTRY != "Antarctica") |>
  st_transform("EPSG:8857")

tmap_mode("plot")
  
  gii_map <- tm_shape(world_map) + 
    tm_polygons(
      fill = "gii_diff",
      fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
        breaks = c(-0.6, -0.15, -0.10, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.3),
        labels = c("Large decrease (< -0.15)",
                   "-0.15 to -0.10",
                   "-0.10 to -0.05",
                   "Small decrease (-0.05 to 0)",
                   "Small increase (0 to 0.05)",
                   "Large increase (> 0.05)"),
        values = "-brewer.rd_bu",
        midpoint = 0,
        value.na = "grey85",
        label.na = "No data"
      ),
      fill.legend = tm_legend(
        title = "Change in GII\n(2019 minus 2010)",
        position = tm_pos_in("left", "bottom"),
        title.size = 0.8,
        text.size = 0.6,
        frame = FALSE
      ),
      col = "white",
      lwd = 0.2
    ) +
    tm_title("Change in GII, 2019 minus 2010\n(blue = inequality reduced)") +
    tm_credits("Data: UNDP Human Development Report; boundaries: Esri World Countries (Generalized)",
               position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom")) +
    tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
  

gii_map

  tmap_save(gii_map, here::here("Week4", "figures", "gii_change_map.png"),
          width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 600)
  
  world_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(gii_diff > 0) |>
  select(COUNTRY, GII_2010, GII_2019, gii_diff) |>
  arrange(desc(gii_diff))

  
```
**Figure 1.** Change in the Gender Inequality Index (GII), 2019 minus 2010.
Lower GII means less inequality, so blue shows improvement and orange shows
worsening. Grey areas have no data for one or both years.
